# laravel_cloud_resend_domains (Data Source)

Lists the organization's Resend sending domains, with the DNS records each needs. The organization must have the Resend integration.

~> This provider is in beta and may change between releases.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "laravel_cloud_resend_domains" "all" {}

output "verified_sending_domains" {
  value = [for d in data.laravel_cloud_resend_domains.all.domains : d.name if d.status == "verified"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) Sending domains, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the domain was added.
- `id` (String) Sending domain ID.
- `last_verified_at` (String) When the domain was last verified.
- `name` (String) Domain name.
- `records` (Attributes List) DNS records to add for the domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains--records))
- `region` (String) Resend region the domain sends from.
- `status` (String) Verification status: `not_started`, `pending`, `verified`, `partially_verified`, `partially_failed`, `failed` or `temporary_failure`.

<a id="nestedatt--domains--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains.records`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Record name, relative to the domain.
- `priority` (Number) Priority of an MX record; null for other types.
- `record` (String) What the record is for, such as `DKIM` or `SPF`.
- `status` (String) Verification status of the record.
- `ttl` (String) TTL, such as `Auto`.
- `type` (String) Record type, such as `TXT` or `MX`.
- `value` (String) Record value.
